name: Machine Maiden Next
original_name: マシンメイデン・ネクスト
source:
Development Company "Spiritual Enterprises".
Many android models have been created here, but research and development costs have risen enormously to go on on one's own. In such circumstances company receives a request from the military to produce battle robots.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
开发公司‘Spiritual Enterprises’。
这里已经制造出许多仿生人型号，但继续独立承担研发工作，成本已高得惊人。就在这种情况下，公司收到军方委托，要求生产战斗机器人。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
